title: Admin & Operations SOP

coverage.automation: 24x7 alert delivery and approved safe action
coverage.s1OutsideCoverage: Best effort until backup On-call or managed service is approved

identity: Named OIDC/MFA account; least privilege; step-up and audit for privileged action.
segregation: Trust decides rights and appeal separation
Platform Admin does not self-approve routine business data

controls: Draft and Review/Decision remain separate states
routine low-risk self-review explicitly flagged and sampled
irreversible deletion, appeal, security exception and material finance/access decision require independent checkpoint

pilotSla.OPS_Q01: acknowledge within 1 operating day; target first review within 2 operating days
pilotSla.OPS_Q02: target review within 2 operating days after readiness passes
pilotSla.OPS_Q03: acknowledge within 2 operating days; target initial decision within 5 operating days
pilotSla.OPS_Q04: P0 immediate safe-hide; P1 within 4 coverage hours; P2 within 1 operating day; P3 within 3 operating days
pilotSla.OPS_Q05: unsafe public data safe-hide in current coverage; High within 1 operating day; normal weekly
pilotSla.OPS_Q06: validate before scheduled start; pause immediately when Sponsored disclosure fails
pilotSla.OPS_Q07: S1 automation 24x7; human ≤60 minutes in coverage; outside hours best effort

evidence: Every material action records case/task, actor, reason, time, result, audit/evidence and next owner.
openInputsBefore1_0: named role holders and backup checkpoint
disclaimer: The Pilot operating decisions are approved. SLA figures are internal targets, not an unconditional customer promise; implementation evidence remains pending.
